Stainless steel.rationale: 304 flat rolled coil; grade unspecified in BOM. European production technology with American upstream conditions; largely cumulative inventory despite UNIT_PROCESS label.

Brass.rationale: No brass production match found. Copper alone is not brass; composition and fabrication are unspecified.

Copper.rationale: USLCI published physical-to-USEEIO bridge; inspect price and sector limitations.

Polypropylene (PP).rationale: Virgin PP resin; excludes conversion into components.

Polyvinyl chloride (PVC).rationale: Suspension-grade PVC resin. Compounding, plasticizers and component extrusion excluded.

Nylon, grade unspecified.rationale: Assume nylon 6 for this scenario; USLCI published USEEIO bridge. Nylon 66 retained as alternative, not inferred from BOM.

Polyoxymethylene (POM).rationale: No POM process match found; PP or generic plastic is not substituted without a defensible inventory or price.

Polycarbonate (PC).rationale: Published USLCI bridge uses PC sheet price with a general plastics sector; does not establish molded PC component impacts.

Acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS).rationale: ABS copolymer resin; component molding excluded.

Silicone.rationale: No silicone elastomer inventory match found; silicon metal and other plastics are not chemically equivalent.

LDPE packaging foil.rationale: LDPE resin only; foil extrusion/conversion excluded. LLDPE stretch film rejected as a different polymer.

Cardboard packaging.rationale: Average corrugated product at mill; assume corrugated cardboard rather than unspecified solid board. Kettle-box converting/printing excluded.
